newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian bullion market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Indian bullion market closed for holiday.

text.p: India's bullion markets were closed on Wednesday for a local holiday and will resume on Thursday, dealers said.
On Tuesday, silver ended higher while gold eased after a favourable opening, dealers said.
"Rising global prices as well as speculative buying pushed prices of silver upwards," one dealer said.
Gold opened up on the back of a price rise in the world market but profit-taking by stockists erased early gains.
